articleTitle: Steam Offers New Highly-Anticipated RPG You Can Try Free Now
articleDescription: A new RPG can be played for free on Steam right now, ahead of its highly anticipated release later this year, and you won’t want to miss out on this opportunity. There are several games that you can test for free on the platform, even if the games themselves are premium paid products. This allows you to know what you’re in for, and if the game clicks with you before you conclude a purchase. Recently, Steam added several free demos for players to check out as part of an event.
